methodology.core: Production execute() timer; includes trace collection when enabled and Greedy sorting; excludes Binary Search ID preparation.
methodology.preparation: Fresh Binary Search ID Merge Sort, timed separately.
methodology.compute_call: External timer around execute(); includes preparation and dispatch, excludes validation, storage, rendering and export.
methodology.wall: Complete benchmark batch including warmups, validation, progress callbacks and event-loop yields; excludes report rendering/export.
methodology.p95: Nearest rank: sorted sample ceil(0.95 × runs); median averages the middle pair for even counts.

limitations: Different algorithms solve different tasks; timings do not form a universal ranking.
No database/network/file access occurs inside timed calls. Browser UI latency and storage latency are not measured.
Warmups reduce but do not remove JIT, GC, CPU contention, timer quantization or background-tab effects.
Memory complexity is theoretical; no heap or process-memory measurement was taken.
Feasibility checks are not real-grid validation; no prediction accuracy applies.
Sequential trace-mode batches do not establish causal timing ratios.
